items.title: Live: Iran vows retaliation over US ship attack; Pakistan prepares to host next peace talks
items.description: Iran's top joint military command accuses the US of violating a ceasefire by firing at an Iranian commercial ship in the Gulf of Oman and vows to retaliate. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: Fair Work Commission makes 'historic' fuel order for truck drivers
items.description: The Fair Work Commission orders that retailers, miners and other companies that use truck drivers and transport operators must hold twice-monthly reviews of fuel prices and adjust their rates accordingly.

items.title: I drove an EV for three days. It saved me money but cost me time
items.description: With no end in sight to soaring fuel prices, 7.30 decided to take an EV for a test drive to see how far it could take our reporter, and if Australia's EV charging network stacks up.

items.title: Australians urged to 'book early' as some rethink holiday and work travel
items.description: The war in the Middle East has caused chaos across some of the world's busiest aviation regions, with many Australians now reconsidering their travel plans — or abandoning them altogether.

items.title: Former footballer Barry Cable found not guilty of sexually abusing child
items.description: Former Australian Rules footballer Barry Cable has been found not guilty of sexually abusing a child in Perth in the 1960s.

items.title: Driver stood down after schoolboy dragged by bus
items.description: Authorities are investigating how a 12-year-old became trapped in a bus door before being dragged hundreds of metres down a suburban street in Melbourne.

items.title: Milk, bread prices to increase within weeks due to war in Iran
items.description: Farmers ask for a 30-cent-per-litre price rise for milk as fuel and fertiliser prices surge.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith reports to police as NSW premier denies 'special treatment'
items.description: Ben Roberts-Smith has been seen reporting to police for the first time since he was released on bail after being charged with the war crime of murder.

items.title: 'Boy are we glad to see you': Diver describes rescue after 20 hours lost at sea
items.description: Stu Fillman was rescued alongside his dive instructor after being carried away from a dive company boat in rough swell.

items.title: Prospector couldn't believe his luck when he found rare australite
items.description: The object formed when a meteorite slammed into Earth more than 800,000 years ago.

items.title: Rebel Wilson accused of defaming actor with sexual harassment claim
items.description: Hollywood star Rebel Wilson is being sued in the Federal Court for defamation by one of the lead actor's in her directorial debut film, The Deb.

items.title: The neighbourhoods where ADHD rates are skyrocketing
items.description: ADHD diagnoses in adults have exploded across Australia since 2017. For the first time, we have the data that shows where it is — and isn't — happening.

items.title: Live: AFL Tribunal to hear Butters appeal in case of umpire abuse
items.description: The AFL Tribunal hears a high-profile appeal against Port Adelaide's Zak Butter's fine for abusive and offensive language against umpire Nick Foot. Follow live.

items.title: Shane Flanagan's sacking is the same old story for St George Illawarra
items.description: St George Illawarra might have sacked coach Shane Flanagan amid a record losing streak, but such struggles have become sadly familiar to the joint venture.

items.title: Quiz: Can you tame our tricky history questions?
items.description: Is two-up actually illegal in Australia? And what movie beat Crocodile Dundee to the top of the box office in 1986?

items.title: 'I had no-one to talk to': The 92yo trying to save his dying language
items.description: Peter is the last living speaker of the First Nations language Thiinma. When he met linguist Rosie, they used music to help keep his knowledge alive, and formed a beautiful friendship along the way.

items.title: Tempted to order in? Try these quick recipes instead
items.description: From frittata to one-pot pasta, these speedy dinners are perfect for busy evenings and worth adding to your regular rotation.

items.title: 'Hard to break the habit': Why free public transport isn't enough to shift from cars
items.description: Free public transport is a popular policy, but researchers say it's not enough to convince drivers to leave the car at home.

items.title: The world is on the cusp of an 'era of extreme scarcity'. Enter Vladimir Putin
items.description: With fears hunger could hit record levels, Vladimir Putin and Russia are poised to capitalise — financially and diplomatically.

items.title: Australia faced the same dilemma as China in 2004 but made the wrong call
items.description: While the rest of us count the cost in higher fuel costs, higher inflation and a weaker economy,  China — the actual winner of the war — will be enjoying a surge of global interest in its solar panels, wind turbines and electric vehicles.

items.title: 'Australia's most expensive soccer pitch' project blows out to $20m
items.description: Five years ago the conversion of a washout-prone natural field to synthetic should've cost $3.3 million. Project changes and a legal dispute with the old contractor has blown out the price.

items.title: Woman tells jury she lied after allegedly seeing mum prepare fatal smoothie
items.description: Maree Mavis Crabtree is fighting three charges at a trial in the Supreme Court in Brisbane, including the murder and attempted murder of her son Jonathan Crabtree.

items.title: What Megan Burslem and Jeremy Fernandez can reveal about ABC Classic 100 in Concert
items.description: The ABC Classic 100 in Concert brings Australia's most popular classical music, as chosen by audiences, from the radio to the stage.

items.title: 'Privilege of my life': ACT Greens leader Shane Rattenbury quitting politics
items.description: The leader of the ACT Greens and former attorney-general Shane Rattenbury has announced he is leaving politics after more than 17 years in the Legislative Assembly.

items.title: Inquest opens into police employee's shooting death at hands of 15yo in 2015
items.description: A coroner will examine what authorities knew about 15-year-old gunman Farhad Jabar in the lead-up to the attack.
